description: Open a browser session for yourself (the Desks plan's D6): POST /api/v1/sessions with run.session-create-request@1. Run places a browser desk on one of your own machines (when you name it or your requirements name user-owned) or on a desk host that serves other people, where every desk runs in its own sandbox, and answers run.session@1. A first-party service acting for a person (X-OV-Subject) opens it for them and is recorded as via. Desk time is metered in desk-seconds.
